scope: 3 saved maps x 3 fixed one-cut methods; no continuation, backtracking, proof or production change

policy.M1: two current child candidate sets, lexicographic bounds then smallest name
policy.M2: M1, otherwise one fixed target and one old neighbor, smallest legal replacement
policy.M3: M1, otherwise same fixed target/blocker, one fixed two-name component; max 3 old sides and distance 2
policy.no_retry: no alternative target, second name, component or repair branch is tried
policy.locality: limits constrain changed old sides, not reading complete boundary constraints

runs.decision_order: new-child bounds lexicographic, then smallest candidate name
runs.validation_scope: all actual old/final boundaries; mutation support is separately bounded
runs.profile_count_definition: union of exact mother/span keys; subdivision counts removed and added records
